goal: Deepen flagship changepoint-detector: make the watch's count default better on clumped orders, under a pre-registered rule
notes: Pre-registered (eval/poisson-window-threshold.prereg.md, committed before any seed ran) two-stage round. Stage A (seeds 601-800): bocpd-window + NB cost at thresholds 0.5/0.4/0.3/0.25/0.2 vs bocpd; 0.3 the highest passing all four bars (0.5, 0.4 fail D2 on S6; 0.25, 0.2 fail F2 on Poisson 5). Stage B (fresh seeds 801-1000, run once): false 3.26 -> 1.03 per 1,000 (-2.23, -2.90 to -1.55), steps 701 -> 1,056 of 1,200, S6 129 -> 145; passes. Shipped as COUNT_DEFAULTS/withCountDefaults in watch-core.mjs, applied when no detector, clumping cost or threshold is named; CLI prints a column line; page, llms.txt, made-repo README and workflow comment updated. One old test (watch-column-detector) compared with 'the default' meaning bocpd and now names bocpd. Not re-measured: the How eager ladder and --detector auto for counts. No agent doc: README section and flagships next: carry what the next run needs.
